defs.def: a group of words which have a particular meaning when used together 成语；习语；惯用法；警句
a short series of notes that form a unit within a longer passage in a piece of music 乐句；乐节

ex.s: Each fable teaches a life lesson that Aesop summarises in a short phrase at the end of the story, called a moral.
ex.t: 每则寓言都教给人一个人生道理，伊索在故事结尾用一句简短的话总结，称为寓意。

defs.def: to say or write sth in a particular way （以某种方式）表达，措辞，推敲
to divide a piece of music into small groups of notes; to play or sing these in a particular way, especially in an effective way 划分乐句，分乐节（尤指为奏乐或歌唱）
